a client"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" that shows each one — grouped by project, with its transcript, diffs, commands, and any
prompt wait"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ing on you. Read a session, answer a prompt, or take over. No account to create, no

you take over. See supported-agent setup for versions and
installati"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"on, and adapter support for the capability matrix."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Foreground clients can join the same broker-owned Codex, Pi, omp, or Reasonix Drive session without "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"starting a
second native Resume. A Claude Code session without the mod keeps its Observe/Take-over f"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"low on
another client, while OpenCode keeps its shared-live behavior. Background Observe connections"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"lient, while OpenCode keeps its shared-live behavior. Background Observe connections stay read-only."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Experimental:** Eight provisional adapters are available to source contributors.
Kimi Code observe"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s every session on a
`kimi web` server read-only, drives the ones cosyncing created — prompts, appro"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"vals, model selection —
and takes over the ones it did not, explicitly. DeepSeek Harness
connects to"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" a `dsh web` host and gives active foreground clients a shared transcript and control
surface, with "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"model and reasoning-effort selection, permission presets, the host's own slash commands,
and image a"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ttachments. General file attachments are not supported — the host accepts image content
only — and b"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ackground resident subscriptions and some message presentation remain follow-up work.
Antigravity re"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ads the Antigravity CLI's own conversation
store — no server involved — replays every conversation r"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ead-only, and drives one through a

session back. omp uses its own packaged bridge and native RPC
dialect "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"for discovery, live sync, prompts, approvals, commands, models, file input, and session

when needed; Node.js/"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"npm are not required. The broker is local-only by
default. Cross-device use requires a proxy, tunnel"},{"id":"p11s3","text":", VPN,
mesh network, or another operator-owned connectivity method.
For a simple private route, see "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"Tailscale Serve; for a
self-managed overlay, see WireGuard or EasyTier. After
`cosyncing setup`, you"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" can also copy
`https://github.com/cosyncing/cosyncing/tree/main/docs/connectivity` to a coding agen"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"t and ask it to
configure your chosen method while keeping the broker bound to loopback.
Tokdash is "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"optional but strongly recommended for quota
tracking and warnings."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"See installation prerequisites for Linux and macOS commands,
WSL notes, and Tokdash setup. For the s"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"igned one-liner installers, see
installing with cosyncing's own installer."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The package contains one JavaScript application bundle and the web client. Supported broker hosts
ar"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e Linux x64, Linux arm64, Apple Silicon macOS, and Windows x64. Windows ARM64 is not qualified
yet, "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"and the broker refuses it — including an x64 process running under ARM64 emulation."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Before setup, install only the agents you use; see [agent setup and PATH
preflight](docs/supported_a"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"gents/README.md#preflight)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Install the current release with one command:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Linux / Apple Silicon macOS:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Windows x64 (PowerShell):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Windows 11 x64 is supported. Windows 10 is not supported: Microsoft Defender may classify the
instal"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ler as a Trojan, and you should not disable Defender to force installation."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The installer verifies the release, installs the broker and a supported desktop client, then
runs in"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"teractive setup and pairs the client. Headless Linux and Linux arm64 receive the server
without a de"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"sktop client. Bun is acquired when needed; Node.js/npm are not required. See the
installer guide for"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" broker-only commands, unattended
installation and signed-channel updates."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"npm distribution ended at **0.6.6**; use the installers above for new installations or migration."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### After setup"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`cosy pair --broker-url https://cosy.example.com` includes that client-reachable origin in a
five-mi"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"nute, one-use QR code. The URL is not persisted or probed. Omit the flag for an
authentication-only "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"offer when the client already knows its broker URL. See the
connectivity chooser. Scan the QR from a"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" client to grant access;
`cosy devices list` lists paired devices, and `cosy devices revoke <id>` re"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" grant access;
`cosy devices list` lists paired devices, and `cosy devices revoke <id>` revokes one."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"After setup, `cosy doctor` diagnoses the machine without changing it, and `cosy status` summarizes
i"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"nstall, service, agents, and sessions."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Privacy and security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The broker runs on your machine, under your account. Broker state is stored there; session content
i"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"s sent only to authenticated clients over the network you choose. cosyncing operates no hosted
servi"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ce in that connection path and includes no analytics or advertising telemetry. Optional
features con"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"tact only the services they name, such as local Tokdash quota data. cosyncing does not
configure or "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"contact connectivity providers; any proxy, tunnel, VPN, or mesh is operator-owned.
Run `cosy update`"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" to update an installer-owned broker and its recorded desktop client."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Report vulnerabilities through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, per SECURITY.md."}],"truncated":true}
